results.rationale: Consistency: white background remains, but the small scissors shift and their blade profile changes; large-scissors handle contours and surface details also change beyond scaling. Instruction: the green-handled scissors remain roughly twice the length of the small pair; the required size match is absent. Quality: both scissors have coherent blades, handles, metallic surfaces and contact shadows without noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: white setting remains, but the smaller turtle becomes smaller and shifts, while shell and facial textures are redrawn on both animals. Instruction: the left turtle is still substantially larger in shell height and body width; the intended reduction to the smaller turtle size is not achieved. Quality: shells, faces, scaly limbs and grounding shadows appear coherent and natural, with no noticeable generation defects.
